newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian soldier on the run after killing six.
newsitem.headline: Russian soldier on the run after killing six.

text.p: A Russian soldier in the Far East killed an unarmed lieutenant and five soldiers with an assault rifle and fled his unit early on Friday, Itar-Tass news agency quoted local military sources as saying.

The agency said the accused 20-year-old soldier waited until fellow conscripts near the city of Gusinoozyorsk put away their assault rifles after they returned to their unit from a military depot they were guarding.
He then opened fire on the men, killing them on the spot. Tass said five other soldiers were in the building, but did not say what happened to them. It was not clear what was behind the attack.
Police and troops of the Transbaikal Military District were searching for the soldier, who was armed with a Kalashnikov assault rifle and ammunition.
Incidents involving soldiers shooting each other have become common in recent years as low morale and cash shortages have taken their toll on Russia's once-mighty military machine.
